goal: 向负责人汇报项目进度并解决延期问题

n1.speaker: 经理 Ms. Wu
n1.line: Good afternoon. Let us review the project status. What has your team completed since the last meeting?
n1.lineCn: 下午好。我们来复盘项目进度。自上次会议以来,你们团队完成了什么?

grammar.name: 现在完成时
grammar.note: has completed 强调从过去至今已完成的动作,常用于汇报阶段性成果。

options.text: We have finished the market survey and have submitted the report to your office.
options.textCn: 我们已完成市场调研,并把报告交到了您办公室。
options.feedback: 成果明确,汇报顺利开始。

options.text: We have made little progress, I am afraid, because of staff changes.
options.textCn: 恐怕我们进展不大,因为人员变动。
options.feedback: 坦承进展缓慢,经理追问。

options.text: We have done everything on schedule, so there is nothing to worry about.
options.textCn: 我们一切按计划完成,没什么可担心的。

n2.speaker: 经理 Ms. Wu
n2.line: Impressive. According to the plan, you should have delivered the prototype by now. Have you?
n2.lineCn: 不错。按计划,你们本应已交付原型。交付了吗?

grammar.name: should have done 完成式情态
grammar.note: should have delivered 表示"本应完成而可能未完成",委婉表达期望与事实的落差。

options.text: Not yet, but we have been debugging it and will have completed it by Friday.
options.textCn: 还没有,但我们一直在调试,周五前会完成。
options.feedback: 如实说明并给出承诺时限。

options.text: We have not, because we had underestimated the hardware cost.
options.textCn: 没有,因为我们当初低估了硬件成本。

options.text: We have finished the prototype, but it had failed several tests before we fixed it.
options.textCn: 原型已完成,但在修复前它失败了好几次测试。
options.feedback: 汇报曲折过程,信息完整。

n3.speaker: 经理 Ms. Wu
n3.line: I see. Had you foreseen these difficulties when we drafted the schedule?
n3.lineCn: 我明白了。我们当初制定日程时,你们预见到这些困难了吗?

grammar.name: 过去完成时疑问
grammar.note: Had you foreseen 用过去完成时询问在制定日程之前是否已预见,追本溯源。

options.text: Honestly, we had not expected the server to break down twice this month.
options.textCn: 老实说,我们没想到服务器这个月会坏两次。
options.feedback: 说明客观原因,经理理解。

options.text: We had anticipated some delays, but never on this scale.
options.textCn: 我们预想过一些延误,但从没想过这么严重。

options.text: We had planned everything carefully; the problems simply appeared out of nowhere.
options.textCn: 我们当初计划得很仔细,问题就是凭空出现的。
options.feedback: 归因于意外,经理继续追问。

n4.speaker: 经理 Ms. Wu
n4.line: Friday is only three days away. Will you have finished the entire testing by then?
n4.lineCn: 离周五只有三天了。到那时你们能完成全部测试吗?

grammar.name: 将来完成时
grammar.note: Will you have finished 表示到将来某一时刻(by then)已经完成,用于核查时限。

options.text: Yes. We will have run all the tests by Thursday evening, leaving one day for fixes.
options.textCn: 能。我们周四晚前会跑完所有测试,留一天修问题。
options.feedback: 给出明确时间表,经理放心。

options.text: I cannot promise that. We had planned to finish today, but the network has been unstable.
options.textCn: 我不敢保证。我们原本计划今天完成,但网络一直不稳定。
options.feedback: 说明变故,经理继续深究。

options.text: We will have finished if nothing else goes wrong, but I am not fully confident.
options.textCn: 如果不再出岔子就能完成,但我不是完全有信心。

n4b.speaker: 经理 Ms. Wu
n4b.line: Good. Now, tell me about the budget. Have you spent what we had allocated?
n4b.lineCn: 好。现在说说预算。你们花完我们当初划拨的款项了吗?

grammar.name: 过去完成时(已拨款项)
grammar.note: we had allocated 用过去完成时,表示拨款发生在花费之前,体现时间层次。

options.text: We have used about eighty percent, and we will have the rest under control.
options.textCn: 我们已用了约八成,其余部分会控制好。

options.text: We have exceeded the budget by ten percent, but the extra cost has been unavoidable.
options.textCn: 我们超支了百分之十,但超出的费用不可避免。
options.feedback: 坦承超支,经理追问细节。

options.text: I have no idea about the numbers. The accountant has been handling them.
options.textCn: 我不清楚数字。一直是会计在管账。

n5.speaker: 经理 Ms. Wu
n5.line: Misfortunes happen. The key is how your team has responded to them so far.
n5.lineCn: 意外在所难免。关键看你们团队迄今如何应对。

grammar.name: 现在完成时(应对)
grammar.note: has responded 强调从问题发生至今的应对动作及其积累效果。

options.text: We have reorganised the team and have added two engineers since last week.
options.textCn: 我们重组了团队,自上星期起新增了两名工程师。

options.text: We have been working overtime for two weeks straight.
options.textCn: 我们已经连续加班两周了。

options.text: We have complained a lot, but have taken little action, I admit.
options.textCn: 我们抱怨很多,但行动很少,我承认。

n6.speaker: 经理 Ms. Wu
n6.line: Then we have a deadline conflict. What had your team done by yesterday to solve the network problem?
n6.lineCn: 那我们就面临期限冲突。到昨天为止,你们团队为解决网络问题做了什么?

grammar.name: 过去完成时(截至昨日)
grammar.note: What had your team done by yesterday 用过去完成时,限定"到昨天"的时间节点。

options.text: We had switched to a backup server by yesterday morning.
options.textCn: 到昨天早上,我们已经切换到备用服务器。

options.text: We had consulted an external specialist, whose advice we are following.
options.textCn: 我们咨询了外部专家,正在按他的建议执行。

options.text: We had done nothing yet, hoping the issue would resolve itself.
options.textCn: 我们什么都没做,指望问题自行消失。
options.feedback: 消极等待,经理严厉批评。

n6b.speaker: 经理 Ms. Wu
n6b.line: Understood. And how many defects have been reported by the testing team so far?
n6b.lineCn: 明白了。迄今测试团队报告了多少缺陷?

grammar.name: 现在完成时被动语态
grammar.note: have been reported 用被动语态,强调缺陷被报告这一事实,不带个人色彩。

options.text: Fifteen defects have been reported, and we have already fixed twelve of them.
options.textCn: 已报告十五个缺陷,我们已修复其中十二个。

options.text: We have not counted them yet, but we will have a full list by tomorrow.
options.textCn: 还没统计,但明天前会有完整清单。

options.text: Too many to count. The testers have been reporting new ones every day.
options.textCn: 多到数不清。测试人员每天都在报告新的。

n7.speaker: 经理 Ms. Wu
n7.line: All right. Looking at the overall picture, has your team delivered every milestone on time so far?
n7.lineCn: 好。纵观全局,你们团队迄今是否按时交付了每个里程碑?

grammar.name: 现在完成时(里程碑)
grammar.note: has delivered 强调从项目开始至今的交付情况,结合 on time so far 限定范围。

options.text: We had met every milestone until last week, when the server failed.
options.textCn: 到上周服务器出故障前,我们每个里程碑都达标了。
options.feedback: 说明过往业绩与转折点。

options.text: We have missed two milestones so far, and we will have caught up by the end of the month.
options.textCn: 至今错过两个里程碑,但月底前会追回来。
options.feedback: 坦承缺口并给出补救计划。

options.text: Honestly, we have not tracked the milestones carefully.
options.textCn: 老实说,我们没有认真跟踪里程碑。
options.feedback: 管理缺位,经理严肃批评。

n7b.speaker: 经理 Ms. Wu
n7b.line: Your efforts are noted. Still, the client has been calling every day. Have you informed them of the delay?
n7b.lineCn: 你们的努力我记下了。不过,客户每天都来电话。你们通知他们延期的事了吗?

grammar.name: 现在完成进行时
grammar.note: has been calling 强调"不断来电"这一持续进行的动作,传达客户的焦灼。

options.text: Yes, we have explained the situation, and they have agreed to extend the deadline by a week.
options.textCn: 是的,我们已解释情况,客户同意延期一周。

options.text: We have not told them yet, because we had hoped to finish before they noticed.
options.textCn: 还没通知,因为我们本指望在他们发现前完成。

options.text: We will have told them by tomorrow. We are preparing a formal explanation now.
options.textCn: 明天前会通知他们。我们正在准备正式说明。

n8.speaker: 经理 Ms. Wu
n8.line: Passive waiting is unacceptable. Had your team taken action earlier, we would not be in this mess.
n8.lineCn: 消极等待不可接受。如果你们团队早点行动,我们就不至于陷入这种困境。

grammar.name: 过去完成时+虚拟语气
grammar.note: Had your team taken action earlier 为虚拟条件句的倒装形式,表示与过去事实相反。

options.text: You are right. Had we acted sooner, we would have avoided most of this delay.
options.textCn: 您说得对。如果我们早点行动,大部分延误都能避免。

options.text: I take full responsibility. Had I urged my team harder, we would have caught up.
options.textCn: 我负全责。如果我当时逼团队更紧,我们早就赶上了。

options.text: It was not our fault. Had the client approved the budget earlier, everything would have been fine.
options.textCn: 不是我们的错。如果客户早点批准预算,一切都会顺利。
options.feedback: 推卸责任,经理彻底失望。

n9.speaker: 经理 Ms. Wu
n9.line: Very well. Let me confirm the new milestones. By the end of next month, the project will have been completed, right?
n9.lineCn: 很好。让我确认新里程碑。到下月底,项目将已完成,对吗?

grammar.name: 将来完成时被动语态
grammar.note: will have been completed 表示到将来某时点将被完成,被动语态突出项目本身。

options.text: Yes. We will have delivered everything by the end of next month, and I will confirm it in writing.
options.textCn: 是的。下月底前我们将交付全部内容,我会书面确认。

options.text: We will have finished the core functions by then; the final polish may take a little longer.
options.textCn: 届时核心功能将完成,最后的打磨可能要久一点。

options.text: I will have to check with the team first, but I will give you an answer tomorrow.
options.textCn: 我得先和团队确认,明天给您答复。
options.feedback: 无法当场承诺,经理不满。

success.speaker: 经理 Ms. Wu
success.line: Then we are aligned. I will report the new schedule to the board today. Do not disappoint me.
success.lineCn: 那我们达成一致。我今天就向董事会汇报新日程。别让我失望。

fail1.speaker: 经理 Ms. Wu
fail1.line: An uncertain answer is not an answer. Come back with a firm schedule.
fail1.lineCn: 模棱两可的回答不算回答。拿一份确定的时间表来见我。

fail2.speaker: 经理 Ms. Wu
fail2.line: I am disappointed by this attitude. In project reviews, excuses without solutions help no one.
fail2.lineCn: 我对这种态度很失望。在项目复盘里,没有解决方案的借口毫无用处。
